task.title: P6-164: Fix DFC face swap for keyword badges and preview flip state persistence
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Accessibility). Original id: P6-164. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**DFC face swap is incomplete in two places** (was `P6-072c` + `P6-072d`): the keywords badge row is card-level (Scryfall unions both faces) and does not participate in the swap (`cards.rs:634-654`, rendered ~`:763`), so a back face renders front-only keywords beside back-face oracle text; and preview flip state survives close/reopen — `PreviewBody` mounts once behind the `hovered`/`sheet_seen` latches so its `face` signal persists, contradicting the "each starting at the front" comment at `cards.rs:161`. Reset or re-document, and pin whichever behavior is chosen with a test.
